import sys
import math

def mod_pow(base, exp, mod):
    base %= mod
    result = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if (exp & 1) == 1:
            result = (result * base) % mod
        base = (base * base) % mod
        exp >>= 1
    return result

def run():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    L = int(data[2])
    R = int(data[3])
    
    MOD = 998244353
    total = n * m
    inv2 = mod_pow(2, MOD - 2, MOD)
    
    diff = R - L + 1
    odd = diff // 2
    even = diff - odd
    
    if total % 2 == 1:
        ans = mod_pow(diff, total, MOD)
    else:
        term1 = mod_pow(diff, total, MOD)
        term2 = mod_pow(abs(even - odd), total, MOD)
        ans = (term1 + term2) % MOD
        ans = (ans * inv2) % MOD
    
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    run()
